question.text: What are the three types of participants in the currency derivatives market?

explanation.text: The Logic: The three participant types in the currency derivatives market are hedgers (reducing risk from underlying exposure), speculators/traders (taking directional views), and arbitrageurs (exploiting price differences across markets). The Trap: Brokers, dealers, importers and similar labels describe entities; they are not the three participation types defined in the workbook. The same entity can act in multiple roles. Note: The three-type classification is supported by pages 43 and 93-94 of the NISM Series-I workbook.
